item.title: Cost of Living in Scoresby Melbourne
item.description:
The cost of living in Scoresby surprises some people. Whether that is a good or bad surprise depends on your budget.

Read our full Scoresby suburb guide for the bigger picture.

Is Scoresby Expensive?

Scoresby sits somewhere in the middle of Melbourne’s cost spectrum. It’s not cheap, but it’s not going to break the bank either — assuming you’re realistic about expectations.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Scoresby, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.

item.title: Scoresby — History and How It's Changed
item.description:
Every neighbourhood has chapters. The most interesting ones for Scoresby involve post-war migration and renewal.

See our full Scoresby suburb guide for the current picture.

What Scoresby Was Originally

Before it was what you see today, Scoresby was agricultural land and market gardens. The original residents built the suburb’s foundation — the street grid, the housing stock, the community institutions that still exist in some form.

Like most of Melbourne, Scoresby’s history is inseparable from the broader story of a city that grew outward from the Yarra in waves. This suburb was settled when Melbourne needed it — whether for housing workers, accommodating families, or providing a retreat from the city centre.

item.title: Scoresby Neighbourhood Guide — Streets and Pockets
item.description:
Scoresby isn’t one monolithic block. Like most Melbourne suburbs, it has different pockets with different personalities. Here’s how to read the suburb from the inside.

See our full Scoresby suburb guide for the overview.

Scoresby Isn’t Just One Thing

Walk from one end of Scoresby to the other and you’ll notice the vibe shift. The main commercial strip has one energy. The residential streets behind it have another. And the edges of the suburb — where it bleeds into Wantirna South — have their own thing going on.
